verdict.rationale: Fern documents and hosts a production MCP server for every docs site with Ask Fern enabled, explicitly designed to connect coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to documentation, and a runtime probe confirms a live JSON-RPC handshake succeeded against the real endpoint. Missing for 10: the advertised endpoint path in llms.txt doesn't match the actual working path (minor documentation inconsistency), and there's no independent third-party corroboration beyond Fern's own docs and the probe.
